description: This file defines the ImportListView class which implements a visual list view component for displaying paginated data sets within the SuiteCRM application. It manages data loading, pagination, and rendering of an import list table using Smarty templates.

classes.name: ImportListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering a paginated list view of imported data within SuiteCRM, leveraging Smarty templates for output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the list view with a data source, pagination parameters, and optional table identifier.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the list view as HTML, with an option to return the generated content instead of outputting directly.

methods.name: getMaxColumnsForDataSet
methods.description: Calculates and returns the maximum number of columns across all data rows for display purposes.

methods.name: generatePaginationData
methods.description: Creates a data structure containing pagination offsets and counts for navigating through the list.
